Test Case Description: Test login with valid username and password.
Test Steps: 1. Go to https://www.saucedemo.com/ 2. Enter valid username: "standard_user" 3. Enter valid password: "secret_sauce" 4. Click on the login button.
Expected Result: User is logged in and redirected to the products page.

Test Case Description: Test login with an incorrect username.
Test Steps: 1. Go to https://www.saucedemo.com/ 2. Enter invalid username: "incorrect_user" 3. Enter valid password: "secret_sauce" 4. Click on the login button.
Expected Result: User receives an error message indicating incorrect username or password.

Test Case Description: Test login with a correct username but incorrect password.
Test Steps: 1. Go to https://www.saucedemo.com/ 2. Enter valid username: "standard_user" 3. Enter invalid password: "wrong_password" 4. Click on the login button.
Expected Result: User receives an error message indicating incorrect username or password.

Test Case Description: Test login with empty username and/or password.
Test Steps: 1. Go to https://www.saucedemo.com/ 2. Leave the username field empty. 3. Enter valid password: "secret_sauce" 4. Click on the login button. 5. Repeat steps but leave the password field empty and fill in the username.
Expected Result: User receives an error message indicating that username or password cannot be empty.
